activation: MLP intermediate after gated activation and before down_proj
selection: Original top 20 frozen Experiment 1 winners; plus the top three animal-minus-tool discovery units and the unit nearest zero discovery d per layer. Extras are exploratory, selected only from Experiment 1 localizer scores.
normalization: z = (activation - mean) / population SD across the 320 Experiment 2 words, separately for each unit. No model rerun or causal intervention.
